name: Lock-free read-only git: hooks, workspace-manager, Commander
goal: Every read-only git command IronClaude launches stops writing the index (and taking .git/index.lock), after a scratch-repo investigation confirms the cause and decides whether git diff also needs diff.autoRefreshIndex=false.
